articles.title: Qualcomm (QCOM) Stock Looks Fully Valued On Royalty Dispute And License Deals
articles.description: QUALCOMM has ridden a strong multi‑year share price climb while signing high profile licensing deals and fighting a major royalty dispute, which naturally raises the question of whether the current market value lines up with the cash the business is expected to generate.
